scenes.broll: Close, high-angle view of a woman's hands slicing a bunch of fresh green asparagus on a thick wooden chopping board on a pale stone worktop in a bright home kitchen in the morning. Her right hand holds a chef's knife partway through six spears laid side by side; her left hand, fingertips tucked, steadies them. Beside the board: a lemon cut in half, a small pile of chopped flat-leaf parsley. Only her hands and forearms are in frame: a woman in her late fifties with a striped sleeve rolled up and short unpainted nails. Sun from a window on the left rakes across the board and throws crisp shadows from the spears. Vertical frame: the upper half is plain sunlit white tiled wall, the board and hands sit just below the centre, the stone worktop fills the bottom. 50mm lens at f/8.
scenes.motion: The knife slowly finishes one cut through the spears and rests on the board; the left hand stays still. The sunlight on the board stays steady. Fixed camera.
